cohort: The study included 428 postpartum mothers with infants aged 6 weeks to 6 months, attending the Young Child Clinic in Kabale regional referral hospital, Uganda.
finding: The prevalence of poor umbilical cord care was 45.8%, with mothers applying various substances, and factors associated with it included primary level maternal education and receiving cord care information from relatives or friends rather than health workers.
cross-section timing: when infants were 6 weeks to 6 months of age
